part.text:
Fixed. The zsh completion for `cp` was broken because the `paths` positional argument in `src/uu/cp/src/cp.rs:423` (the `operand_arg()` builder) lacked `.num_args(1..)`, so clap_complete generated a single optional positional (`'::paths:_files'`) — after typing the first file, zsh stopped offering path completion. I added `.num_args(1..).required(true)` (matching `mv`'s `ARG_FILES` definition), which makes the generator emit the repeatable `'*::paths:_files'` spec.

Verified:
- `coreutils completion cp zsh` now outputs `'*::paths:_files'`
- `cp` with no args produces clap's "required arguments were not provided" error (fixes `test_cp_no_file`), single-arg still reports "missing destination file operand"
- `cargo test --features cp cp::`: 266 passed; the only 4 failures are pre-existing environment issues (permission/mount tests, also failing on the unmodified baseline)
